_comment: Merged onto neotree/security-ci security/policy.defaults.json. Only the deltas belong
here; anything matching the defaults is duplication that will silently drift.

Changes here are security-sensitive: Code Owner review plus a security-reviewed:<sha7> label.

exceptions.reason: Express rule matching Next.js's compiled app-page handler (renderer.render(NodeNextRequest, NodeNextResponse, ctx)) in committed build output; no application code reaches it. Remove when build/ stops being committed or security-ci scopes Express rules away from artifact_globs.

Matches Next.js's internal 'changed from static to dynamic at runtime ... reason: ${description}' error string in committed build output; it is a thrown message, not HTML. Remove with the res-render-injection exception.

Matches drizzle-orm's set-operator builder (sql.raw(`${'union'|'intersect'|'except'} ${'all '}`)) in the committed server bundle; both values are library constants. Source code is still scanned without this exception.

axios's bundled setImmediate shim posts a random `axios@<n>` token to its own window and its listener only accepts that token from that same window; no data crosses origins. Source code is still scanned without this exception.
